content: शौटीर {%a.%} [शौटेः ईरन् <ls>Uṇ. 4. 31</ls>] .²1 Liberal, munificent. .²2 Proud, haughty, proud of (in <ab>comp.</ab>); शौटीरशूरसदृशमनीकजनसंसदि <ls>Mb. 5. 162. 31</ls>; विक्रमशौटीरः <ls n="Mb.">3. 252. 21</ls>. .{@-रः@} .²1 A hero, champion. .²2 A proud man. .²3 An ascetic, one who has given up worldly pursuits; <ls>Mb. 12. 83. 44</ls> (<ab>com.</ab> शौटीरः प्रगल्भः). .²4 An upstart. .{@-रम्@} manliness.
